description: Add a real-time event timeline to the issue detail page that merges issue and workflow events into one chronological, human-readable feed with category color coding, attention emphasis, filters, and live SignalR updates.

tasks.title: Event data layer: API client, query hook, and live event accumulation pub/sub
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Web client fetches merged issue events from the events endpoint, specs/web-ui/spec.md#Live event path accumulates events for timeline display
tasks.description: Add the data pipeline that feeds the timeline: a typed StoredCloudEventDto type, a getIssueEvents() API client function and useIssueEvents() React Query hook (using the non-['issues'] query key ['issue-events', number, projectId] to avoid prefix-collision refetches), a timeline-events.ts EventTarget pub/sub (mirroring rebase-events.ts), and a dispatchTimelineEvent forward call inside LiveTaskProvider.handleEvent that runs after all existing invalidation/toast logic so existing behavior is preserved. This task delivers the complete data layer: history fetch + live event channel, both testable independently of any UI.
acceptanceCriteria: getIssueEvents(number, projectId) calls GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/{number}/events and returns StoredCloudEventDto[]

useIssueEvents(number) uses query key ['issue-events', number, projectId] — NOT a key starting with ['issues', ...] — so LiveTaskProvider's invalidateQueries({queryKey:['issues']}) does not trigger a refetch on every live event
timeline-events.ts exports dispatchTimelineEvent and onTimelineEvent following the same EventTarget pattern as rebase-events.ts

LiveTaskProvider.handleEvent dispatches a TimelineLiveEvent (with issueNumber, issueId, type, time, payload) after the existing switch logic; the existing invalidateQueries calls and toast notifications continue to fire unchanged

Unit tests verify: the API client builds the correct URL; the query key is ['issue-events', ...]; dispatchTimelineEvent/onTimelineEvent round-trip works; LiveTaskProvider forwards events without suppressing existing invalidation/toast behavior
Web lint and typecheck pass (npm run lint, npm run typecheck in packages/web)
tasks.output: entities/issue/model/types.ts (StoredCloudEventDto), entities/issue/api/client.ts (getIssueEvents), entities/issue/api/queries.ts (useIssueEvents), entities/issue/model/timeline-events.ts, app/providers/LiveTaskProvider.tsx (dispatch forward), entities/issue/index.ts (exports), plus unit tests
tasks.notes: Critical correctness detail: the query key MUST be ['issue-events', number, projectId], not ['issues', number, projectId, 'events']. See design D2.

tasks.title: Event timeline widget: classification, rendering, live merge, and Issue Detail integration
tasks.spec: specs/issue-event-timeline/spec.md, specs/web-ui/spec.md#Issue Detail page renders Activity event timeline panel
tasks.description: Build the complete event timeline UI surface in a new widgets/issue-event-timeline/ module: pure classification functions (classify.ts — priority-ordered 6-category classifier with attention flags; source-tag.ts — ISSUE/WORKFLOW from type prefix; describe.ts — human-readable description formatter), a useEventTimeline hook that merges useIssueEvents history with onTimelineEvent live events (deduped by CloudEvents id with type+time fallback, capped at 500 live entries), and the UI components (EventTimelinePanel with Live badge + category filter chips with counts + newest-first/chronological toggle + sticky day separators; EventTimelineRow with colored dot, category tag, source tag, timestamp, expandable mono detail for failures; CategoryFilter chips). Integrate by rendering EventTimelinePanel in IssueDetailPage's main column between the diff/commits area and Comments, passing issueNumber, issueId, and workflowStatus.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening an issue detail page shows the Activity timeline panel between the diff/commits area and the Comments section
The timeline loads and displays historical events from useIssueEvents on page open, showing an empty state when no events exist
While the workflow is active (workflowStatus === 'running'), new SignalR events for the current issue appear in the timeline in real time with an enter animation, without a page reload

Each entry shows a human-readable description (e.g. 'Stage moved from Plan to Build', 'Issue labeled bug', 'Rebase conflict detected on 3 files') and a timestamp — never a raw event type string as the primary message
Events are classified into 6 categories with correct colors: workflow/lifecycle=blue, approval=amber, integration=purple, success=green, failures=red, metadata=gray

Failures (stage/run/merge failed, rebase conflict) and attention-required events (approval requested, base drift needs-attention) have a tinted background and haloed dot; failure rows have an expandable inline mono detail block
Issue events and workflow events appear interleaved in one merged, timestamp-ordered feed with ISSUE/WORKFLOW source tags — not two separate lists
Category filter chips show per-category counts and narrow the feed when selected; clearing filters shows all events
Default ordering is newest-first; a toggle flips to chronological; sticky day separators appear when the feed spans multiple days
A pulsing Live badge appears while workflowStatus === 'running' and is de-emphasized when inactive
The stage/task view (WorkflowView) and runtime decision surface remain visible and are not displaced by the timeline panel
The timeline panel contains no state-mutating controls (no approve/retry/start/close/reopen/comment actions)
Live events that duplicate loaded history events are not displayed twice (dedup by CloudEvents id)

Unit tests cover: classifyEvent priority ordering and attention flags for all 6 categories; classifySource for ISSUE vs WORKFLOW; describeEvent output for representative event types including unknown-type fallback; useEventTimeline merge + dedup + ordering; EventTimelinePanel rendering of rows, filters, live badge, and empty state
Web lint and typecheck pass (npm run lint, npm run typecheck in packages/web)
tasks.output: widgets/issue-event-timeline/ module (index.ts, model/{types,classify,source-tag,describe}.ts, ui/{EventTimelinePanel,EventTimelineRow,CategoryFilter}.tsx, useEventTimeline hook), IssueDetailPage.tsx integration, plus unit tests
tasks.notes: See design D1 (module structure), D4 (merge/dedup hook), D5 (priority-ordered classification), D6 (source tag prefixes), D7 (description templates with prettified-type fallback), D8 (placement between diff/commits and Comments), D9 (Live badge from workflowStatus).
